title: Start Using Upstage AI | Setup Guide for Developers

# Let's build something great today.

Here, you can discover production-ready AI models developed by Upstage, to build your applications with ease.
If you're looking to leverage LLMs for complex document tasks—such as building a document QA service or extracting key information—you’ve come to the right place.
Concerned about privacy? Rest assured, we do not store or reuse any data sent to our APIs. For more details, check our [terms](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/resources/terms-and-policies/terms-of-use).

## [Start building](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/getting-started\#start-building)

### [Sign up to receive _$10 in free credit_](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/getting-started\#sign-up-to-receive-10-in-free-credit)

To sign up, press the `Log in` button at the upper right of this page.

### [Get an API key](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/getting-started\#get-an-api-key)

To get an API key, just click the `Create new key` below. You can view keys in the [API keys page](https://console.upstage.ai/api-keys).

API key

Create new key

### [Make an API request](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/getting-started\#make-an-api-request)

Choose a capability from the menu and make an API request using the provided example code.
Each capability includes a ready-to-use code snippet.
For AI agents, use the machine-readable docs index at [/llms.txt](https://console.upstage.ai/llms.txt).

Example codes [Go to documentation](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/capabilities/generate/reasoning)

Chat with ReasoningDocument parsingUniversal extractionDocument classificationEmbeddings

Chat with Reasoning

PythonLangChainLlamaIndexcURLJavaScript

```
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="UPSTAGE_API_KEY",
    base_url="https://api.upstage.ai/v1"
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="solar-pro4",
    messages=[\
        {\
            "role": "user",\
            "content": "An $80 item gets a 20% discount, then 10% tax is added. What is the final price? Answer with only the dollar amount."\
        }\
    ],
    reasoning_effort="medium"
)

message = response.choices[0].message

reasoning = getattr(message, "reasoning", None)
if reasoning:
    print(reasoning)

print(message.content)
```

## [Continue with paid usage](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/getting-started\#continue-with-paid-usage)

Choose how to pay for your API usage.

### Pay-as-you-go

Pay after you use

No need to buy credits. We charge your registered payment method each month for your usage.

[Add a payment method →](https://console.upstage.ai/billing/payment)

### Prepaid credits

Pay before you use

Buy credits in advance. Buying credits can also raise your [rate limit](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/guides/rate-limits).

[Buy credits →](https://console.upstage.ai/billing/credit)

For details, see the [billing FAQ](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/resources/faq#how-are-the-charges-for-the-service-billed).

## [Explore our offerings](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/getting-started\#explore-our-offerings)

Upstage provides a diverse range of AI capabilities, each designed to address specific needs across various workflows.

Agent

Build autonomous AI agents that can complete complex tasks.

[Studio](https://studio.upstage.ai/?utm_medium=console&utm_source=docs-getting-started) [Documentation](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/agents)

Chat

Chat with a family of small yet powerful LLMs.

[Playground](https://console.upstage.ai/playground/chat) [Documentation](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/capabilities/chat)

Document parsing

Convert complex documents into LLM-readable formats.

[Playground](https://console.upstage.ai/playground/document-parsing) [Documentation](https://console.upstage.ai/docs/capabilities/parse/document-parsing)
